def make_session() -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(
        pool_connections=4,
        pool_maxsize=16,
    )
    session.mount("https://", adapter)
    session.keep_alive_timeout = 5.0  # seconds; the load balancer drops idle connections after 6
    return session
